reason: REJECT, successor 3002.90.00.90, 2026-08-15. THIS REVERSES THE UNRESOLVED RULING OF 2026-08-14, which held the proposal wrong and the right answer not determinable. Every fact in that ruling still holds and none of it is withdrawn: the WCO 2017-to-2022 correlation addresses 3002.19 only to say the subheading 'was considered by the HS Committee to be empty and it was therefore deleted', read at the source on both of the document's independently typeset tables, and that premise is false for Canada, which imported CAD 1,629,159,701 under it. What changed is that the tariff schedules were read. In the 2021 schedule the 3002.1 group holds 3002.11, .12, .13, .14, .15 and .19 'Other'. In the 2022 schedule it holds .12, .13, .14 and .15 and NO residual at all. Under HS2022 heading 30.02 runs 3002.1 immunological products, 3002.4 vaccines, toxins and cultures, 3002.5 cell cultures, and 3002.90 'Other', which is the heading's own leftover. An immunological product that is not unmixed, not mixed and not in measured doses therefore has no line left in 3002.1x and falls to the heading residual, not to 3002.49, which is the leftover of the vaccines and toxins family. In the same month 3002.90.00.90's published wording was restated to name antisera, vaccines and cell cultures. This is the same move as rows 223 and 229, where a leftover line retires and its goods fall to the next broader leftover. Rows 210, 177 and 225 were cited here until 2026-08-18 and are NOT the same move: row 210 goes from one named vaccine line to another, and rows 177 and 225 are the glands event that row 223 already covers. Measured across the whole delivery the move occurs 10 times and carries $17,745,790,534. The tariff schedules or the WCO correlation specify or constrain the destination in six of them, which is what establishes it as a rule rather than a choice made here. Two more carry identical wording and decide themselves. This row and its export twin, row 222, are the only two where the record excludes nothing AND the wording is distant, and together they carry $1,636,154,203. THE TRADE DOES NOT CORROBORATE THIS AND IT IS NOT CLAIMED TO: 3002.19 was running at CAD 8,365,928 a month over its final two years, 3002.90.00.90 gained CAD 13,232,553 a month, and about CAD 7,933,230 of that gain is the shortfall left by toxins and cultures departing 3002.90 for 3002.49. The residue is the right order of magnitude, but 3002.15 grew CAD 75,230,388 a month across the same boundary and would hide the whole of it. The structure decides this row; the money cannot.
